en: Sepia-toned postcard showing the full front facade of a multi‑storey brick building with a central entrance and balconies. A large rooftop sign reads "HOTEL de PAUW". On the ground floor are shopfront windows with awnings and signage for a lunchroom and café-restaurant belonging to the hotel. At the bottom margin, printed text identifies the establishment as Hotel-Café-Restaurant 'de Pauw' in Nijmegen, with its street address and telephone number.
